text.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

words.gloss_range: sequential and resultive opening particle binding the death scene to the prior service frame
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as a bound next movement. It resumes the prior labor scene and makes the death episode a consequence-stage, so the disclosure of ignorance begins as the continuation of service under divine command rather than as an isolated report.

topics.headline: consequence-boundary opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the death scene as the next consequence of the prior service narrative, not as a detached anecdote.
topics.reason: The prefixed particle scopes over the first temporal frame and links the new scene to the preceding discourse.

words.gloss_range: completed temporal threshold that places divine decree before creaturely evidence
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) suspends the main disclosure until the decree is complete. The particle creates the first threshold: death has already become real before any sign can point observers toward it.

topics.headline: completed threshold before evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gap between completed reality and later evidence.
topics.reason: The first temporal particle governs the completed decree clause before the negated evidence clause begins.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person divine decree that takes death as its executed object
words.root_gloss_range: deciding, decreeing, judging, completing, and bringing a matter to execution; here the decree-execution branch governs death
words.prose: {{ar:قَضَيْنَا}} ({{tr:qaḍaynā}}) makes death an enacted decree, not a bare notice that Sulayman died. Its perfect first-person plural form puts divine completion before all signs, and the transitive structure turns death into the object brought into effect. The decree root can fix command elsewhere (17:23), but here it fixes mortal termination. That start drives the whole chain: hidden death, eroded support, collapse, and exposed ignorance.

topics.headline: death as executed decree-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that death is governed and completed before anyone perceives it.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural verb directly governs the death noun and carries explicit divine agency.

topics.headline: decree begins the proof chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the decree as the hidden condition that organizes every later visible sign.
topics.reason: The clause starts the sequence whose material consequences later disclose what observers did not know.

topics.headline: decree root shifts from command to death
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the decree root moving from command-fixing elsewhere (17:23) into death-fixing here.
topics.reason: The q-d-y field supports decisive judgment and completion, with Quranic parallels where decree fixes command or death.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun marking death as imposed upon the prior central figure
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) compresses burden and reference into one word. The preposition frames the death decree as bearing upon him, while the suffix forces the reader to carry Sulayman forward from the prior ayah into this unnamed death scene.

topics.headline: death borne upon the prior figure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both adverse imposition and cross-ayah pronominal continuity.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the decree verb and the suffix resolves backward to the prior Sulayman frame.

words.gloss_range: definite death as decreed reality before it becomes indicated information
words.root_gloss_range: death, lifelessness, cessation, and states of non-living; here bodily death is real before it is recognized
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَوْتَ}} ({{tr:al-mawta}}) names death first as the definite object of decree. The later possessed death-word will name the same reality as information to be indicated, so this first occurrence keeps ontology ahead of recognition: the death is true before it is visible.

topics.headline: death as definite decree-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices death as an established reality, not merely a visible event.
topics.reason: The definite accusative verbal noun is the direct object of the decree verb.

topics.headline: death split from recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated death root split real occurrence from later recognition.
topics.reason: The first death-word is the decreed object, while the later possessed death-word belongs to the indication construction.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening a restriction frame that empties the scene of indicators before the exception
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) first removes the whole field of indicators. The coming exception can then stand out as the only source of disclosure, and the ayah's proof begins with an evidentiary void rather than with an immediate explanation.

topics.headline: negation before sole exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the scene emptied of ordinary signs before the low exception appears.
topics.reason: The negation prepares the exception structure and excludes every other indicator.

topics.headline: four-beat proof architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the ayah as decree, restricted sign, collapse, and verdict.
topics.reason: The row names the larger architecture generated by the negated evidence clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect indication verb with the jinn as receivers and the subject delayed to the exception
words.root_gloss_range: pointing, indicating, guiding, and directing toward something; here indication becomes forensic exposure through material signs
words.prose: {{ar:دَلَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:dallahum}}) lets indication do the arguing. The object suffix places the jinn as receivers before the subject is named, so the reader waits to learn what managed to point them to the death. The root's guidance range is narrowed here into forensic exposure: mute material damage becomes the sign-chain that proves ignorance.

topics.headline: receivers named before low subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences surprise because those needing indication appear before the low source of indication.
topics.reason: The verb carries the plural object suffix while the subject is withheld until the exception.

topics.headline: guidance root becomes forensic evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah proves ignorance through signs rather than direct accusation.
topics.reason: The d-l-l verb points to death through a material sign-chain, with guidance-like indication narrowed into exposure.

topics.headline: audience embedded in the sign event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the exposed audience built into the indication itself.
topics.reason: The attached object suffix fuses the indication event with its exposed recipients.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the indicated target rather than the sign recipients
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) separates who received the sign from what the sign was about. In the indication construction, the preposition points the evidence toward his death as the informational target.

topics.headline: preposition of evidential direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is oriented toward death, while the jinn remain merely the receivers.
topics.reason: The preposition marks the object of indication and keeps it distinct from the plural object suffix on the verb.

words.gloss_range: possessed death as the specific hidden fact indicated by the sign
words.root_gloss_range: death and cessation; here the root returns as a possessed hidden state made knowable by indication
words.prose: {{ar:مَوْتِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:mawtihi}}) returns death as a possessed state, not as the decree-object already named. The grammar moves death into the indication frame, making the same reality pass from divine occurrence into creaturely recognition only through a sign.

topics.headline: death as possessed indicated information
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that his death is now the information targeted by indication.
topics.reason: The construct with suffix is genitive after the preposition and belongs to the indication construction.

topics.headline: one root across occurrence and report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated death root create a two-stage reading: occurrence first, recognition later.
topics.reason: The repeated m-w-t terms split decreed reality from later recognized proof.

words.gloss_range: exceptive particle making the earth-creature the sole successful indicator
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) turns the prior negation into exclusivity. All other possible indicators are excluded, and the low earthbound agent becomes the only remaining route by which the hidden death is known.

topics.headline: sole exception inside indicator field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a scale reversal: the only successful indicator is the low creature, not occult expertise.
topics.reason: After negation, the exceptive particle restricts the class of indicators to the earth-creature.

words.gloss_range: indefinite earth-creature made the effective subject of indication
words.root_gloss_range: persistent movement, habitual action, and creaturely going; here the low moving creature becomes the effective indicator
words.prose: {{ar:دَآبَّةُ}} ({{tr:dābbatu}}) is low and unspecified, yet it becomes the effective subject of the indication. The wording lets a persistent moving creature outperform the observers: slow material action supplies the evidence that supposed hidden knowledge did not. The comparison with a speaking earth-creature (27:82) sharpens the local scene, where testimony is silent and physical.

topics.headline: low creature as decisive subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that syntactic agency is given to the low creature against expectations of higher knowledge.
topics.reason: The nominative excepted noun functions as the actor fulfilling the negated predicate.

topics.headline: persistent movement as evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees slow creaturely persistence become more effective than claimed hidden perception.
topics.reason: The creature word and root field support movement and persistence, narrowed locally to the staff-eating mechanism.

topics.headline: silent material testimony contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast with the earth-creature that speaks (27:82), while this one testifies by action.
topics.reason: The concrete reference supports a contrast in how an earth-creature bears witness.

words.gloss_range: genitive earth-domain specifying the creature and grounding the disclosure in ordinary matter
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, and earthly domain; here it grounds the sign source and, through variant pressure, can sharpen toward a wood-eating creature
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) grounds the indicator. The construct phrase keeps the source earthly rather than heavenly or occult, while variant pressure can sharpen the scene toward a wood-eating creature without replacing the base earth-domain reading. The payoff is that ordinary matter becomes the refutation of unseen-knowledge prestige.

topics.headline: earth-domain source of disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disclosure comes from earthbound matter, not from an occult source.
topics.reason: The genitive construct specifies the indefinite creature by a definite earth domain.

topics.headline: variant sharpens wood-eating mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel how the variant reading sharpens the creature toward a wood-eater while the base wording remains earth-domain language.
topics.reason: Accepted variant pressure clarifies the material mechanism, but the base local word remains the genitive earth noun.

topics.headline: earth refutes unseen prestige
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth as the low domain from which the proof against unseen-knowledge claims emerges.
topics.reason: The local earth term is later opposed to the unseen domain named at the ayah close.

words.gloss_range: imperfect eating verb describing the creature actively eroding the support
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, and wearing away; here ordinary consumption functions as erosion of the support
words.prose: {{ar:تَأْكُلُ}} ({{tr:taʾkulu}}) keeps the mechanism visible. The feminine imperfect agrees with the creature, not the jinn, and its ordinary Form I consumption narrows here into erosion of the staff. The act bridges the exception to the fall: eating becomes the physical way hidden death collapses into sight.

topics.headline: feminine imperfect tied to creature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disclosure action belongs to the creature, not to the watching jinn.
topics.reason: The 3FS imperfect follows and agrees with the creature as a circumstantial action.

topics.headline: eating as support erosion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees eating not as incidental feeding but as the mechanism that weakens support until proof appears.
topics.reason: The staff object selects consuming-away as erosion, and the imperfect keeps the process ongoing.

topics.headline: biological consumption after grandeur
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices monumental production narrowed into a small biological act that decides the scene.
topics.reason: The eating motif shifts from destruction imagery (105:5) into a local proof mechanism after the prior manufacturing scene.

words.gloss_range: possessed staff as the concrete support whose erosion delays and then releases recognition
words.root_gloss_range: postponing, extending, delaying, and the concrete staff noun associated with that field; here support and delayed recognition converge
words.prose: {{ar:مِنسَأَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:minsaʾatahu}}) is the ayah's material hinge. It is the creature's direct object and his own support, so the sign comes from the failure of what held the dead body upright. The staff noun also carries n-s-ʾ delay pressure: it literally supports the body and lexically makes recognition feel postponed until collapse releases it. The variant pressures are specific: possession keeps the support his, hamza treatment affects how audible the delay-root remains, and segmentation would expose the boundary that the base reading keeps as one possessed support noun.

topics.headline: his own staff as consumed support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disclosure emerges from the failure of the dead figure’s own support.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object of eating and has a 3MS possessive suffix.

topics.headline: staff as postponement device
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the staff as both physical support and the lexical device of delayed recognition.
topics.reason: The n-s-ʾ field of postponement and the concrete staff sense converge locally.

topics.headline: variants expose the support-word boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see how possession, hamza, and segmentation affect the delay-pressure while the base reading remains one possessed support noun.
topics.reason: The variants alter possession, hamza force, or word boundary, but they do not replace the canonical object relation.

words.gloss_range: second sequential particle making the fall a result of staff erosion
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) restarts the chain at the collapse threshold. After the eating of the support, it is resultive: the fall follows as consequence, not as an unrelated new scene.

topics.headline: eating leads to fall threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the collapse is sequenced as the result of support failure.
topics.reason: The prefixed particle scopes over the second temporal frame and binds it to the preceding eating clause.

words.gloss_range: second temporal threshold making collapse the trigger for clarification
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) creates the matching threshold to the opening one. First death became real after decree; now death becomes knowable after fall. The repeated temporal frame makes the ayah's delay legible as two stages: reality first, disclosure second.

topics.headline: fall as release-point for clarification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recognition is triggered by completed collapse, not by death or eating alone.
topics.reason: The particle governs the fall verb and is answered by the clarification verb.

topics.headline: two lamma thresholds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees decree and fall as paired thresholds: hidden reality and visible disclosure.
topics.reason: The repeated particle structure pairs the opening death threshold with the later fall threshold.

words.gloss_range: completed intransitive collapse selected over voluntary prostration
words.root_gloss_range: falling down with force, collapse, and sometimes prostrating fall; here the staff context selects involuntary collapse
words.prose: {{ar:خَرَّ}} ({{tr:kharra}}) is the visible failure that turns hidden death into evidence. The verb is intransitive and perfect, so the body simply falls after support is gone; the root's forceful impact pressure survives, while the staff context selects involuntary collapse rather than worshipful prostration. The fall is not the conclusion but the trigger for clarification.

topics.headline: body itself falls into evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the body itself becoming evidence once external support fails.
topics.reason: The perfect intransitive verb completes the temporal protasis and has no direct object.

topics.headline: fall root narrowed by staff context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the root’s forceful fall pressure while the local staff-and-death frame excludes voluntary prostration.
topics.reason: The root can describe worshipful falling elsewhere (19:58), but this context selects forensic collapse.

topics.headline: collapse triggers interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fall as the threshold that releases the verdict, not as the final point of the story.
topics.reason: The verb sits inside the second temporal frame before the clarification clause.

words.gloss_range: Form V clarification after collapse, with variant pressure around who is made clear
words.root_gloss_range: separation, clarity, evidence, and becoming clear; here physical collapse becomes belated clarification
words.prose: {{ar:تَبَيَّنَتِ}} ({{tr:tabayyanati}}) turns collapse into understanding. The base Form V makes clarity emerge after ambiguity, while the variant readings show that the agency and target of clarification are grammatically live. Placed before the subject, the verb foregrounds the event of disclosure before naming the exposed group, and it joins the surah's concern with hiddenness and clarification (34:3).

topics.headline: collapse becomes proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fall is interpreted into clarity, not merely observed as a motion.
topics.reason: Form V supports becoming clear or ascertaining after the collapse event.

topics.headline: active-passive disclosure agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that variant agency affects whether clarification is framed as arising with the jinn or being made clear about them.
topics.reason: The base and passive readings shift semantic agency without changing the local disclosure event.

topics.headline: belated verification of hiddenness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices verification arriving late, after failed perception has already exposed the claim to hidden knowledge.
topics.reason: The b-y-n and ghayb field, including 34:3 and 49:6, supports the clarification as belated proof.

words.gloss_range: definite collective jinn as the exposed experiencer group, with concealment denied as knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, and hidden beings; here concealed nature is separated from access to the unseen
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِنُّ}} ({{tr:al-jinnu}}) names the exposed group after the clarification verb. In the base reading they are the nominative experiencers whose ignorance becomes clear; variant pressure can reroute the learning role toward humans, but the local point remains that concealed beings do not thereby possess the concealed domain. References to restricted unseen disclosure (72:26-27) make that denial sharper.

topics.headline: hidden group exposed as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the jinn as a definite class exposed by the event, not as isolated actors.
topics.reason: The base nominative collective follows the clarification verb as the group whose ignorance becomes clear.

topics.headline: variant reroutes who learns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how variants can shift the learning role while preserving the critique of jinn knowledge.
topics.reason: The variant with humans as learners and jinn embedded changes case roles but remains apparatus beside the base reading.

topics.headline: concealed beings lack unseen access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that beings associated with concealment fail to know what is concealed.
topics.reason: The j-n-n concealment field is paired with ghayb language, while syntax denies possession of that domain.

words.gloss_range: content marker turning the clarification into a stated counterfactual proposition
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) moves the ayah from event to inference. What became clear is not only that a body fell, but the proposition that follows: the logic of their failed knowledge claim. Variant pressure from a strengthened boundary would reroute the following syntax and subject roles, while the base wording keeps the counterfactual as the content clause.

topics.headline: content clause after clarification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrative becoming an explicit proof statement.
topics.reason: The complementizer introduces the counterfactual content of what became clear.

topics.headline: boundary sensitive to stronger anna reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see how a strengthened variant boundary would reroute syntax without controlling the base content clause.
topics.reason: The variant pressure is useful apparatus, while the base reading remains the simple content marker.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual particle making unseen knowledge an unreal premise tested by non-remaining
words.prose: {{ar:لَّوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) makes the final statement a proof by unreal condition. The premise is not simply imagined; in this past counterfactual frame it is denied by the result: if they had known the unseen, their remaining would have been otherwise.

topics.headline: unreal condition proves ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar itself denying the claimed hidden knowledge.
topics.reason: The particle governs the condition and reaches forward to the negated apodosis.

topics.headline: content clause and unreal result combine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as a grammatical proof, not as loose commentary after the story.
topics.reason: The particle joins directly to the plural support verb and generates a condition-result structure.

words.gloss_range: plural deficient verb framing knowledge as an unreal sustained state of the jinn
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, and auxiliary state-framing; here it frames supposed knowledge as an unreal sustained state
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) makes the claim broader than a missed fact. With the imperfect knowledge verb, it frames a supposed ongoing state of knowing, while the plural ending keeps the jinn present inside the unreal condition. The matching plural perfect later measures that supposed state against their remaining.

topics.headline: knowledge as sustained unreal state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the failure as lack of a sustained knowledge-state, not one isolated mistake.
topics.reason: The deficient verb with an imperfect predicate frames ongoing capacity under a counterfactual particle.

topics.headline: same group through condition and result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps hearing the same exposed group through indication, unreal knowing, and non-remaining.
topics.reason: Plural morphology resumes the jinn without repeating the noun.

topics.headline: state of being answered by remaining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their supposed state of knowing tested against their actual state of remaining.
topics.reason: The k-w-n plus knowledge pairing and the echo with the remaining verb create a balanced proof.

words.gloss_range: imperfect knowing verb taking the unseen as direct object inside the unreal condition
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, being aware, and possessing knowledge; here the claim tested is direct knowledge of the unseen
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) identifies the denied capacity: direct knowledge of the unseen, not general cleverness. The Form I verb tests possession of knowledge itself, while the surrounding counterfactual shows that any knowledge here arrives through evidence, not innate hidden access. Quranic ghayb formulas such as 6:59 and 72:26 sharpen the contrast between divine possession of the unseen and the jinn's failure.

topics.headline: knowing takes the unseen as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tested claim is object-access to the unseen, not vague intelligence.
topics.reason: The Form I imperfect governs the definite unseen object inside the counterfactual premise.

topics.headline: knowledge arrives by evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah opposing innate hidden access to knowledge produced by signs.
topics.reason: The knowledge verb is tested by the earlier indication chain and falsified by the result.

topics.headline: failed jinn knowledge versus divine ghayb formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the local failed claim beside Quranic restrictions on unseen knowledge (6:59; 72:26).
topics.reason: The ʿ-l-m plus ghayb field makes the local failure part of a broader restricted-knowledge formula.

words.gloss_range: definite singular unseen domain as the object whose knowledge is denied
words.root_gloss_range: absence from perception, concealment, hidden reality, and the unseen domain; here the definite object names the denied domain of knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبَ}} ({{tr:al-ghayba}}) names the issue only near the end. It is definite and singular, so the ayah is not about one secret alone but about access to the unseen domain, a restricted-access field marked explicitly elsewhere (72:26). The earlier death, staff, eating, and fall now read backward as proof that hidden existence is not the same as hidden knowledge, especially for concealed beings.

topics.headline: recognized hidden domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tested object is the unseen as a recognized domain.
topics.reason: The definite accusative singular noun is the direct object of the knowing verb.

topics.headline: hidden does not mean nonexistent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Solomon’s death as real while absent from perception, making hiddenness itself the tested domain.
topics.reason: The gh-y-b field marks absence from perception, not nonexistence.

topics.headline: late epistemic climax and restricted access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the late word as the narrative climax: everything before it has been proof about unseen access.
topics.reason: The term belongs to a restricted ghayb field, with 72:26 naming God as knower of the unseen.

words.gloss_range: negative particle in the counterfactual apodosis making non-remaining the unreal result
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the result clause, not the whole story as simple past denial. Under the counterfactual, it states what would have followed from true unseen knowledge: they would not have remained, so their actual remaining becomes evidence against the premise.

topics.headline: non-remaining as unreal result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices duration turning into disproof because non-remaining is the expected counterfactual result.
topics.reason: The particle negates the apodosis verb under the counterfactual condition.

words.gloss_range: plural perfect remaining verb that makes ignorance measurable as duration inside punishment
words.root_gloss_range: remaining, tarrying, staying for a duration; here duration becomes the measure that disproves hidden knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:لَبِثُوا۟}} ({{tr:labithū}}) turns ignorance into duration. It is intransitive and located by the following phrase, so the jinn's remaining is measured inside punishment. The verb sits in the negated result: true knowledge would have meant not remaining, and the prior staff-delay makes this final duration echo the physical delay that concealed death.

topics.headline: intransitive remaining located by following phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remaining as a completed counterfactual duration inside a state, not as an action with an object.
topics.reason: The verb is intransitive and the following prepositional phrase supplies the enclosing condition.

topics.headline: duration disproves hidden knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how long they remained as the proof that they did not know the unseen.
topics.reason: The l-b-th root names tarrying, and in the apodosis it becomes the outcome that true knowledge would have avoided.

topics.headline: staff delay echoed by remaining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices physical deferral and punitive duration mirroring one another inside the ayah.
topics.reason: The staff delayed visible death, while this verb names the continued duration that proves ignorance.

words.gloss_range: preposition locating remaining inside punishment as a container-like state
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) attaches to remaining, not to knowing. It makes punishment the place-like condition in which duration occurs, so the proof closes not only on failed knowledge but on continued enclosure in a degrading state.

topics.headline: remaining enclosed in punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures their remaining as enclosure inside punishment rather than a single missed perception.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to the remaining verb and governs the punishment noun.

topics.headline: phrase carries proof into final state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the proof land in the endured state at the ayah close.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase carries the counterfactual into the final punishment expression.

words.gloss_range: definite punishment noun naming the painful enclosing condition, with broader root branches narrowed by humiliation
words.root_gloss_range: punishment, painful consequence, and other branches such as sweetness or freshness; here the punishment branch is selected and intensified by humiliation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) names the state in which remaining would not have continued under true knowledge. The definite governed noun makes punishment a known enclosing condition, not vague hardship. Broader ʿ-dh-b sweetness or freshness branches are visible only as contrast: here the following humiliation adjective selects painful punitive consequence. Together the noun and adjective form a degrading-punishment formula (4:14), so the close becomes lived status-loss as well as pain.

topics.headline: known punitive environment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the proof ending in an endured punitive condition, not merely in an abstract logical conclusion.
topics.reason: The definite genitive verbal noun is governed by the preposition and foregrounds the punitive state.

topics.headline: punishment branch selected over sweetness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can retain the root contrast while knowing that the local phrase selects degrading punishment, not sweetness.
topics.reason: The broader root contains other branches, but the local phrase with the humiliation adjective selects painful punishment.

topics.headline: pain and status-loss together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final consequence is both punitive suffering and status reversal.
topics.reason: The recurring degrading-punishment formula, including 4:14, joins the noun with the humiliating adjective.

words.gloss_range: definite active participle adjective making the punishment actively humiliating
words.root_gloss_range: lowliness, humiliation, abasement, and causative degrading; here the active participle makes punishment produce status-loss
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُهِينِ}} ({{tr:al-muhīni}}) seals the ayah on degradation. Its agreement makes humiliation integral to the punishment phrase, and its active participle force makes abasement something the punishment produces. The familiar degrading-punishment formula (22:57) is made local to exposed hidden-knowledge prestige, and the final long īn cadence leaves the proof sounding on status-loss, not only pain.

topics.headline: humiliation modifies the punishment itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humiliation as part of the punishment itself, not a loose added quality.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the punishment noun in definiteness and genitive case.

topics.headline: active humiliation reverses prestige
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the punishment actively producing abasement that reverses any prestige of hidden knowledge.
topics.reason: The Form IV active participle gives the adjective causative degrading force.

topics.headline: degrading-punishment formula at the final word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on humiliation as the final stress of the proof.
topics.reason: The adjective participates in the recurring degrading-punishment formula and occupies the ayah final position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from death, through no indication, to hidden eating, collapse, and clarification.
baseline_models.mechanism: Death is complete but socially unread. A minute earth-creature consumes the support by hidden attrition; the resulting fall converts an accumulating material cause into a public sign.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the concealed state that the standing posture fails to disclose.
Indication by a mark makes the creature-mediated collapse an evidentiary route to the hidden fact.
Hidden creeping supplies an imperceptible causal process that can advance without being sensed.
The wood-eating earth-creature identifies the materially exact agent that removes the support.
Consumption as corrosion turns ordinary eating into progressive structural failure.
A disturbed, sounding fall externalizes what silent decay and death had concealed.
Emergence into clarity is the epistemic result produced by the physical collapse.

changed_reading.before: The death is simply announced and then noticed.
changed_reading.after: The death remains operationally hidden until incremental material decay removes a support; collapse transforms a local trace into shared knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The staff at word 13 stands between decreed death and the jinn's prolonged humiliating labor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The staff is simultaneously a physical prop, an image of driving, and an image of delay. It preserves a readable posture of command after life has ended, so a coercive arrangement outlasts its living commander until the prop is consumed.

activation_trace.role: The executed decree of death fixes the commander's living agency as already ended.
Delay names the staff as the material means by which recognition is postponed.
Driving with a staff gives the same prop a disciplinary role in the labor mechanism.
Remaining in place is the prolonged behavioral effect sustained by the unread posture.
Punitive pain identifies continued labor as coercive rather than neutral duration.
Humiliation marks the social degradation produced by obedience to an empty posture.

changed_reading.before: The staff is an incidental support beside a dead body.
changed_reading.after: The staff is a control-bearing prop: it delays disclosure and preserves the appearance of command, allowing degrading labor to continue without living authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The jinn become clear or come to clarity precisely through a sign that disproves their knowledge of the unseen.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concealed beings do not access a concealed fact by ontological status. Knowledge arrives through an external mark, so the ayah distinguishes being hidden from knowing what is hidden.

activation_trace.role: The hidden beings supply the status whose presumed epistemic privilege is tested.
What is screened from sight defines the disputed object of knowledge.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the capacity explicitly denied by the counterfactual.
A resolvable sign replaces status as the actual route to knowledge.
Uncovering marks the transition from presumed access to evidence-based recognition.

changed_reading.before: The clause only denies one fact to the jinn.
changed_reading.after: The clause states an evidence rule: concealed beings learn a concealed fact from a material sign, not from their concealed mode of being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening tracks what enters and exits the earth and denies that even an atom-weight is absent from divine knowledge. That scale sharpens the focus contrast: the tiny underground process is unseen to creatures but never informationally absent.

activation_trace.role: Hidden creeping anchors the focus mechanism in an action below ordinary perception.
The wood-eating earth-creature localizes the microscopic process within the focus ayah.
Knowledge as disclosure frames the inventory of movements that creatures may miss.
Entry into another thing supplies the downward, interior movement echoed by hidden consumption.
Emergence outward completes the entry-exit tracking against which later disclosure is read.
Minute and dispersed particles establish the smallest scale as still fully accounted for.
Hiddenness is assigned to what escapes eyes, not to what escapes divine knowledge.
Manifest clarity in the record anticipates the focus movement from concealment to disclosure.

structural_cues: 34:2 inventories entry into and exit from earth alongside descent and ascent.
34:3 places every atom-weight in a manifest record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive vertical and microscopic tracking; I infer that this scale governs the unnoticed earth-creature process. A live alternative is that the opening states omniscience without specifically prefiguring the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts jinn ignorance with one accidental piece of evidence.
changed_reading.after: The focus locates creaturely ignorance inside a fully tracked micro-order: the event is hidden only relative to limited observers, while its smallest material stages remain known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier scoffers sarcastically offer to point others toward a man announcing re-creation, and the surah then asks them to see a possible fall as a sign. In the focus, an earth-creature becomes the effective indicator and a fall settles what prestigious observers could not know.

activation_trace.role: Effective indication in the focus is assigned to the creature-mediated material sign.
The body's fall is the decisive visible event that completes the indication.
The scoffers' claimed act of pointing supplies a sarcastic human counter-image to the creature's true indication.
The summons to ocular and inward seeing makes failed perception a recurring problem.
A visible sign establishes material events as legitimate disclosure rather than low-status noise.
A threatened downward fall prefigures falling as an event that forces recognition.

structural_cues: 34:7 uses the same indication root in a taunt.
34:9 joins seeing, a possible fall, and a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated indication and fall language; I infer a prestige reversal in who successfully directs whom. The live alternative is simple lexical recurrence without a deliberate answer to the taunt.

changed_reading.before: The creature is merely the unlikely cause of discovery.
changed_reading.after: The lowly creature becomes the surah's successful guide: its sign answers failed and mocking human guidance by making a fall tell the truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding gifts display control over softened iron, calibrated connected work, molten copper, and fixed monumental vessels. The focus then reveals that this material order can depend on one organic support vulnerable to slow, hidden corrosion.

activation_trace.role: The wood-eater introduces an exact low-scale vulnerability into the material system.
Corrosive consumption supplies the failure process that engineered scale does not prevent.
The staff is the small load-bearing and disciplinary object on which the visible arrangement depends.
Softening against hardness supplies an image of extraordinary material tractability.
Iron and resistant solidity establish the durable material register later countered by eaten wood.
Measured planning makes the preceding manufacture an ordered engineered system.
Molten copper expands the system from worked iron to controlled industrial flow.
Fixed, rooted vessels supply monumental stability as the contrast to the falling body.

structural_cues: 34:10-13 moves from softened iron and measured links to molten copper and fixed cauldrons.
34:14 immediately narrows from monumental production to one staff and one eater.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material-scale contrast; I supply the systems arrow that a vast arrangement can hinge on a weak support. A live alternative is that the manufacture list catalogs gifts without intentionally foregrounding fragility.

changed_reading.before: The eaten staff is an isolated marvel in the death scene.
changed_reading.after: The eaten staff is the weak point of a monumental engineered order, exposing how apparent material mastery can depend on a small degradable support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context identifies jinn as makers working before Solomon under command and threat of punishment. It therefore specifies the focus's humiliating punishment as prolonged coerced production, while the staff's driving branch explains how the command posture remains legible.

activation_trace.role: Driving by a staff makes the prop a compact image of disciplinary command.
Prolonged remaining is the temporal burden imposed on the workers.
Punitive pain explicitly classifies that prolonged state as torment.
The concealed beings are identified as the laboring population in the preceding arrangement.
Purposeful work supplies the concrete activity later described as prolonged punishment.
Threatened punishment establishes the coercive sanction behind the work.
Repeated making and commands to work intensify the production setting immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 34:12 says the jinn work before him by permission and threatens deviation with torment.
34:13 repeats work around large manufactured objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work, command, threat, and the focus phrase prolonged humiliating punishment; I infer that the latter points back to coerced production. A live alternative is that the focus punishment is broader distress rather than the work itself.

changed_reading.before: The jinn remain in an unspecified humiliating punishment.
changed_reading.after: They remain at commanded production under a sanction whose living enforcer is already dead; the humiliation is labor prolonged by unread authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Iblis passage supplies a model in which supposition becomes effective through following despite the absence of coercive authority. Applied to the focus, the dead body contributes no living power; the workers' inference that command persists, together with the staff's support, reproduces its effects.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life removes the actual capacity of the apparent commander.
The delaying prop preserves the sensory premise on which mistaken obedience can continue.
The workers' continued remaining is the behavioral effect needing explanation.
Supposition and imagined certainty supply a belief that can become behaviorally consequential.
Following converts an unforced belief into sustained action.
The explicit absence of power or authority separates causal influence from actual coercive capacity.

structural_cues: 34:20 joins a fulfilled supposition to people following it.
34:21 denies Iblis coercive authority and frames the result as a test of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies influence without authority; I map that causal pattern onto the dead ruler's still-effective posture. A live alternative is that the Iblis passage concerns belief testing independently of the focus labor scene.

changed_reading.before: The corpse somehow continues to command because it remains upright.
changed_reading.after: The corpse commands nothing; authority survives as a worker-side inference, and belief plus a material prop lets a powerless posture continue producing labor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointed day cannot be deferred or advanced, while the focus staff carries a delay image. The resulting distinction is exact: the decree and death occur on time, but observers' recognition is postponed until the support fails.

activation_trace.role: The executed death decree fixes the event as accomplished rather than suspended.
Delay belongs to the staff and therefore to disclosure, not to the death itself.
Slow stopping and delay describe the costly duration created by late recognition.
Deferral to a later time is explicitly denied of the appointed event.
Advancing or preceding supplies the opposite temporal displacement, likewise denied.

structural_cues: 34:29 asks when the promise is due.
34:30 says its appointed day can be neither delayed by an hour nor advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immovable deadline and a focus object whose branch image is delay; I assign delay to observer knowledge rather than to the decreed event. The live alternative is that the lexical echo is accidental.

changed_reading.before: The staff appears to postpone Solomon's death.
changed_reading.after: Nothing postpones the death; the staff postpones only its social registration, sharply separating event time from disclosure time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later the angels say people worshipped the jinn, while the reader is told to reflect and reject the charge of jinnah. The focus becomes a demythologizing disclosure: concealed beings are themselves limited knowers, and mental covering belongs to those who confuse hidden status with hidden knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The concealed beings anchor the focus target whose epistemic prestige is dismantled.
Their coming into clarity turns the scene into disclosure about them as well as to them.
The unseen is the domain falsely inferred from the beings' own hiddenness.
Submissive worship supplies the inflated religious status that the focus scene punctures.
The same concealed beings are named as misplaced objects of devotion.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the demanded alternative to prestige-based inference.
Mental covering supplies a semantic mirror for observers whose judgment is obscured.

structural_cues: 34:41 identifies the jinn as objects of misplaced worship.
34:46 commands solitary or paired reflection and denies jinnah in the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared J-N-N inventory but distinct lexical senses; I use their adjacency as a rhetorical mirror, not as identity of meaning. A live alternative is no intentional root-play between the focus jinn and the later jinnah accusation.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a private failure within the jinn workforce.
changed_reading.after: The focus publicly strips occult prestige from the jinn: hidden beings are exposed as evidence-dependent, while unreflective observers display the deeper covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, the same throwing root describes God casting truth as knower of the unseen and unbelievers throwing claims at the unseen from afar. The focus supplies a third epistemic mode: a local contact process leaves a material sign that defeats remote projection.

activation_trace.role: Indication by a mark anchors the focus in evidence rather than projected assertion.
Contact corrosion supplies the local causal trace from which the hidden state is inferred.
Casting truth supplies authoritative projection joined to knowledge rather than distance.
The plural unseen is explicitly paired with the one who knows it.
Throwing from afar supplies the contrasting image of an unsupported claim launched toward its object.
The hidden domain becomes the target of speculation rather than established knowledge.

structural_cues: 34:48 joins casting truth to knowledge of the unseen.
34:53 reuses casting for claims aimed at the unseen from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired casting clauses; I place focus evidence between them as contact-based correction. A live alternative is that the final casting contrast targets speech alone and does not classify the creature's material sign.

changed_reading.before: The creature's eating is a curious way to reveal death.
changed_reading.after: The eating models grounded knowledge: local causal contact produces a sign, unlike claims projected at the unseen from epistemic distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending moves through panic, missed access, attempted reaching from afar, and a barrier. This sharpens the focus sequence into punitive belatedness: the jinn finally know after collapse, but knowledge arrives only after they have already spent the unrecoverable duration in labor.

activation_trace.role: Collapse is the irreversible threshold after which the hidden fact becomes undeniable.
Disclosure occurs only on the far side of that threshold.
The prolonged stay is the already-incurred cost that later knowledge cannot cancel.
Failure of apprehension and access supplies the terminal condition of being too late.
Reaching by extension supplies the desired access that distance now prevents.
A separating barrier turns delayed recognition into irreversible exclusion.
Separation between parties and desired objects formalizes the closure of access.

structural_cues: 34:51-52 moves from no escape to attempted reaching from a distant place.
34:54 ends with a barrier between people and what they desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a terminal pattern of access recognized after its loss; I infer the same cost structure in the focus's post-collapse knowledge. A live alternative is that the closing eschatological scene is analogous but not explanatory of the jinn's duration.

changed_reading.before: The collapse corrects ignorance and ends the episode.
changed_reading.after: The correction is itself timed as judgment: the jinn learn truly only after an unrecoverable interval of humiliating labor, so belated knowledge carries the cost of prior misreading.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the eater as a counter-worker within a production ecology rather than merely a biological cause. It remains anchored in the earth-creature, eating, corrosive branch, driving staff, and the neighboring garden sequence of eating, yield, and replacement. Downstream prose should present it as a material-ecological analogy, not as a claim that the creature intentionally rebelled.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The earth-creature eats the staff whose preserved posture keeps the jinn at humiliating work.

activation_trace.role: Hidden creeping lets a negligible worker alter the system outside the notice of its visible workforce.
The wood-eating earth-creature grounds the reading in a concrete ecological agent.
Corrosive eating makes consumption the act that terminates the labor arrangement.
The eaten staff carries the driving function whose material removal ends discipline.
Commanded eating situates consumption within the neighboring ordered garden economy.
Fruit and yield supply the productive form of eating's object before ecological reversal.
One thing replacing another supplies the larger ecological reversal echoed by the staff's destruction.

changed_reading.before: The creature is a negligible biological cause in a royal death scene.
changed_reading.after: The earth-eater can be carried as an ecological counter-worker: unnoticed consumption redistributes agency and shuts down coerced production from below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears tabayyanat al-jinn as disclosure about the jinn, not only cognition by them. It remains anchored in the B-Y-N appearance branch, the J-N-N hidden-being branch, and the following counterfactual that specifies their ignorance. Downstream prose should call this an exploratory grammatical-semantic echo, not replace the ordinary realization reading with a categorical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The construction tabayyanat al-jinn stands between the body's fall and the counterfactual denial that the jinn knew the unseen.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and uncovering permit the fall to disclose the jinn's condition as well as the death.
The concealed beings become the very object whose limitation is made visible.
Knowledge disclosed to a knower supplies the ordinary realization sense that the outlier retains rather than discards.
The hidden domain defines the limitation exposed by their prolonged labor.
Later naming the hidden beings as objects of worship raises the stakes of publicly exposing their limitation.

changed_reading.before: The fall only gives the jinn information about Solomon.
changed_reading.after: The fall also gives the audience information about the jinn: hidden beings become legible as ignorant of the hidden.

strongest_changes: The staff postpones recognition, not death, separating event time from disclosure time.
The immediate work-and-threat context identifies the prolonged humiliating punishment as coerced production sustained after living authority ends.
The Iblis passage makes authority behavioral: supposition and following can preserve effects even where actual power is absent.
The surah's opening and close turn the tiny material sign into a test of evidence against prestige, distance, and belated access.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted a marvel narrative into an inspectable mechanism linking microscopic decay, load-bearing material, worker belief, coercive labor, and the timing of knowledge while preserving the stranger ecological and self-exposing echoes as exploratory.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the repeated indication, fall, and sign language intentionally answers the mock guidance of 34:7.
Whether the Iblis model of influence without authority is meant to explain the jinn's continued labor or only parallels it.
Whether tabayyanat al-jinn can carry disclosure about the jinn alongside the ordinary sense that they realized.
How tightly the garden economy of 34:15-16 should be connected to the earth-creature's consumption.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hidden death becomes knowledge through slow material disclosure.** `ء ر ض/B010` is the wood-eating termite, `ن س ء/B001` deferral beyond its time, `خ ر ر/B001` a rumbling fall, and `ب ي ن/B004` appearance and becoming clear. The support delays visible collapse while an earth-creature consumes it; the fall then separates appearance from actuality. Consumption is the hidden clock, collapse the disclosure event, and clarification its cognitive result. The packet gives those stages; I infer that deferred structural failure carries information forward. The ayah reads knowledge as materially produced by decay, correcting claims to unseen knowledge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:48-53 repeatedly oppose knowledge of the unseen to distant verbal casting, making the termite’s slow, local disclosure the surah’s decisive model of warranted knowledge.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Delayed collapse as an epistemic mechanism.** `ن س ء B001` supplies deferral beyond its time, `د ل ل B001` indication by a sign, and `خ ر ر B001` a rumbling fall. Death occurs, but its public indication is deferred until the staff is consumed and the body falls. The branches assign the staff delay, the creature indication, and the fall disclosure. The packet supplies this sequence; I infer that continued support causes the knowledge lag. The scene reads as a demonstration that visible stability can outlast the reality it appears to certify.

2. **Imperceptible creeping defeats a claim to the hidden.** `د ب ب B003` supplies imperceptible creeping spread, `ء ر ض B010` the wood-eating termite, and `غ ي ب B001` what is hidden from sight or knowledge. A tiny earth-process works unseen inside the support while hidden beings remain unaware of death. The branches give creeping the causal role and claimed hidden knowledge the failed diagnostic role. The packet supplies eater, collapse, and realization; I infer the contrast between effective hidden process and ineffective claim. The ayah reads as an epistemic reversal: the least visible material agent exposes the limits of those associated with invisibility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:18's visible settlements and 34:19's conversion of people into circulating tales showed what happens after delayed disclosure: a hidden failure becomes visible and then socially reportable. This extended the fall from private diagnostic event into public knowledge.

baseline.text: Süleyman'ın ölümüne hükmettiğimizde, asasını yiyen bir yer canlısından başkası cinlere onun öldüğünü göstermedi. Süleyman düşünce cinler anladı ki görülmeyeni bilselerdi aşağılayıcı azap içinde kalmazlardı.

findings.text: Görünürde ayakta kalan destek, ölümü bir süre gizler; yavaş tüketim gizli bir saat, düşüş ise görünüş ile gerçeği ayıran maddi bir açıklama olayı haline gelir.
Neredeyse fark edilmeyen küçük bir maddi süreç, görülmeyeni bildiği sanılan varlıkların bilgisizliğini açığa çıkararak görünmezlik ile bilgi arasındaki bağı tersine çevirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A concealed condition becomes publicly legible when an enclosing surface or load-bearing support fails.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Threatened cosmic fracture and the quiet erosion of a staff share a disclosure logic: structural failure converts what was denied or unknown into visible evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eroded Support Exposes Delayed Ignorance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Death has already occurred, but labor continues until a wood-eating process consumes the support, causes collapse, and reveals the workers' ignorance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: decisive completion (`quranic:root_001237:B003/m01`), loss of life and power (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`), wood-eating termite resonance (`quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`), consumption (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`), corrosion or decay (`quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`), staff or goad (`quranic:root_001493:B002/m01`), noisy collapse (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`), becoming manifest (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`), prolonged remaining (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Authority appears to persist because its support remains upright after life has gone. Minute consumption eventually makes the hidden temporal gap material, so collapse becomes an epistemic event.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı karara bağlama anlamıyla kesin bir buyruk verme anlamını aynı dalda açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kesinlik, yalnızca kararın söylenmesini değil, konunun ayrılıp sonuçlandırılmasını da anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bildirimde bulunmayı, bir işi bitirmeyi, borç ödemeyi veya ölümü değil; bağlayıcı bir yargı ya da kesin buyruk vermeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, hükme bağlama ve kesin buyruk verme çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır; başka dallara özgü kalıp anlamları bu tanıma katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir uyuşmazlığı hükme bağlayıp taraflar için kesin bir karara varmak veya bir işi bağlayıcı bir buyrukla kesinleştirmektir.

facets.statement: Uyuşmazlığı değerlendirip taraflar arasında bağlayıcı bir karara varma.
Bir işi kesin ve bağlayıcı bir buyrukla sonuçlandırma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çekirdeği karar verme ve işi kesin biçimde sonuca bağlama olarak ortaklaşa sunar; yargısal kullanımda bu, taraflar arasındaki ayrımı bağlayıcı bir hükümle belirler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yargısal karar ile bağlayıcı buyruğun ortak çekirdeğini, konuyu kesin biçimde sonuca bağlama yönüyle birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Karar verme, bağlayıcılık ve kesin sonuca bağlama özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki bir uyuşmazlığın yargısal kararla çözülmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyuşmazlığı bağlayıcı bir kararla sonuçlandırma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yargı dışındaki kesin buyruk verme kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin yapılmasını bağlayıcı ve kesin bir buyrukla belirleme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Taraflar arasında yargısal karar verme yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قضى إليه عهدا، والإعلام والإيحاء والإنهاء والإبلاغ إلى المخاطب

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ölümün bir kişiye erişip yaşamını sona erdirmesini, kişinin ölmesini, birini öldürmeyi ve ölümü kaçınılmaz biçimde uygulanan son olarak adlandırmayı birlikte destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki ölüm ve öldürücü sonuç sınırı bu kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca yaşamın sona ermesi veya sona erdirilmesiyle ilgilidir; genel bitirme ve tamamlanma anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, ölümle ilgili ad biçimlerini ve yalnızca verilen söz öbeklerinde ortaya çıkan ölme ya da öldürme anlamlarını ayrı tutar; bunlar çıplak biçime tek bir genel anlam olarak yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Ölümün bir canlıya erişerek yaşamı kesin biçimde sona erdirmesi veya bir eylemin o canlının ölümüne yol açmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ölümün gerçekleşmesiyle bir canlının yaşamının kesin olarak sona ermesi.
Bir eylemle canlının yaşamını sona erdirip onu öldürme.
Ölümü, kaçınılmaz biçimde yürürlüğe giren son veya öldürücü güç olarak adlandırma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, ölümün gerçekleşmesi ile birini öldürme kullanımlarını ortaklaşa verir ve ölümün geri çevrilemeyen, uygulanan bir son olarak adlandırılmasını bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yaşamı sona erdiren temel olayını hem kendiliğinden gerçekleşen ölüm hem de öldürme yönleriyle karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşamın kesin sona erişini ve bu sonun bir eylemle gerçekleştirilebilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölümün kişiye eriştiği ve yaşamın sona erdiği söz öbeklerinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlının yaşamının ölümle sona ermesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir başkasının eylemiyle öldürme ve ölümü adlandırma yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir darbe, zehir veya başka bir etkenin canlının ölümüne yol açtığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir eylemle yaşamı sona erdirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin ölmesi ve ölümün kaçınılmaz son olarak adlandırılması yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölümü veya ölümleri geri çevrilemeyen ve yürürlüğe giren son olarak adlandıran biçimlerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ölümün kesin ve geri çevrilemez son oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Ölme olayının katılımcı yapısını ve doğrudan öldürme eylemini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ölümü kaçınılmaz biçimde yürürlüğe giren son olarak adlandıran kullanımları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvan ölümü, ceset ve öldürme buyruğu gibi daha geniş adlandırmaları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da canlının yaşamının sona ermesini ve buna yol açmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ölümün kesin olarak gerçekleşmesi çevresinde örgütlenir; komşu dal ölüm, ceset ve öldürmeye ilişkin daha geniş bir kullanım alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öldürme eylemini ve ölümü yürürlüğe giren kaçınılmaz son olarak görmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir topluluğun hiç kimse kalmayacak biçimde tükenmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bireyin yaşamının sona erdiği ölüm olayını karşılar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bireysel ölüm ve öldürme çevresindedir; komşu dal bu çekirdeği bir topluluğun bütünüyle ortadan kalkmasına kadar genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sona eren şey canlı yaşamıdır ve öldürme katılımcısını da barındırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İş, süre, gereksinim veya nesnenin tamamlanmasını ve tükenmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da geri çevrilmesi güç bir sona ulaşma düşüncesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın kurucu sonucu ölümdür; komşu dalda ise canlılık şartı olmadan bir iş tamamlanır ya da bir şey sona erer.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel ölüm, yaşamın sona ermesi ve aynı kökün genel bitiş dalı en açıklayıcı karşılaştırmaları verdi, ani ölüm ve yaralıyı öldürme gibi daha dar örnekler yinelenmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قضى عليه الموت، وقضى نحبه بمعنى مات، والقتل، والقاضية والمنية، والمنايا المنفذة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل فراغ أو تمام، ولا القضاء بمعنى الحكم إلا إذا كان السياق هو المنية
branches.source_phrase_ar: فلما قضينا عليه الموت أي أتى والقاضية المنية (ayn); ضربه فقضى عليه أي قتله وقضى نحبه أي مات (sihah); فلما قضينا عليه الموت أي أتى عليه والقاضية المنية (tahdhib); يعبر عن الموت بالقضاء وقضى نحبه معناه مات (mufradat); سميت المنية قضاء لأنه أمر ينفذ (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir gereksinimi, ibadeti, süreyi veya başka bir işi tamamlayıp bitirme ile bir şeyin geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve yok olması aşamalarını açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçeve, tamamlanan eylem ile sona eren şey arasındaki katılımcı farkını koruduğu sürece uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem bir işi bitirmeyi hem de bir şeyin sona erip tükenmesini kapsar; ölüm ve borç ödeme ancak kendi ayrı dallarında ele alınır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, sona erme bildiren biçim ile belirli iş, gereksinim, ibadet ve süre söz öbeklerini ayırır; bu kalıpların bütün ayrıntıları çıplak biçime yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, gereksinimi, ibadeti veya süreyi son sınırına ulaştırıp tamamlamak; ya da bir şeyin süresi dolarak geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve ortadan kalkmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi veya süreci gereken son sınıra ulaştırarak tamamlayıp bitirme.
Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı sona ererek geçip gitmesi ve tükenmesi.
Bir işin artık geri alınamayacak biçimde kesin olarak sonuçlanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir işi bitirip ondan çıkma ile bir şeyin süresinin veya varlığının tükenip gitmesini aynı sona ulaşma çevresinde birleştirir; bazı kullanımlarda sonuç geri alınamaz duruma gelir.

concept_gloss.text: tamamlayıp bitirmek veya sona erip tükenmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Etkenin bir işi bitirmesi ile bir şeyin kendiliğinden sona erip ortadan kalkması arasındaki ayrımı koruyarak dalın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tamamlama, son sınıra ulaşma, tükenme ve ortadan kalkma yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gereksinim, ibadet, yükümlülük veya süre gibi bir işin sonuna ulaştırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Etkenin bir işi son sınırına ulaştırıp bitirmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyin kendiliğinden tükenip ortadan kalkması yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı biterek geçip gittiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sona erme, geçip gitme ve tükenme yönlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir etkenin işi bilinçli olarak tamamlayıp bitirmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin geri alınamayacak veya düzeltilemeyecek biçimde tamamlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonucun kesinleşmesi ve geri alınamaz duruma gelmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tamamlama ile tükenip yok olma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin tükenip geçmesi ve ortadan kalkması sonucunu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eksik olanı tamamlayan parça ve bir topluluğun sayıca tamamlanması gibi kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işin veya şeyin gereken son sınıra ulaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal eksiksiz ve tam duruma gelmeyi öne çıkarır; odak dal buna ek olarak işten çıkmayı, sürenin dolmasını ve varlığın tükenmesini içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir gereksinimi, ibadeti veya işi etken olarak tamamlayıp bitirmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yol, vadi ve kumluk gibi uzamsal şeylerin uç veya bitim noktasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin devamının kesilerek son sınıra ulaşmasını karşılar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem etkenli tamamlama hem tükenip gitme sürecidir; komşu dal daha genel kesilme, zamanın bitmesi ve uzamsal son nokta çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlılık şartı olmadan iş, süre, gereksinim veya nesnenin tamamlanmasını ve tükenmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaşamın ölümle sona ermesini ve bir canlının öldürülmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir sürecin artık sürmediği kesin bir son vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel tamamlanma ve tükenmedir; komşu dalın kurucu sonucu yalnızca yaşamın sona ermesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tamlığa ulaşma, kesilip sona erme ve ölümle bitiş en yararlı sınırları gösterdi, son parça veya dökme gibi daha uzak adaylar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفراغ من الحاجة والعبادة والمناسك، تمام الأمر، انقضاء الشيء وفناؤه، وقضاء الأجل والوطر والعبرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه القضاء القضائي، ولا الوصية إلى المخاطب، ولا الديون إلا من جهة أدائها
branches.source_phrase_ar: انقضى الشيء وتقضى أي فني وذهب (ayn); بمعنى الفراغ وقضيت حاجتي وانقضى الشيء وتقضى (sihah); قضي الأمر أتم إهلاكهم وقضى صلاته فرغ منها والانقضاء ذهاب الشيء وفناؤه (tahdhib); فإذا قضيتم مناسككم وليقضوا تفثهم وأيما الأجلين قضيت وفلما قضى زيد منها وطرا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi yapmak, biçimlendirmek ve kusursuzca tamamlamak ile tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla yürürlüğe koymayı ortak bir sonuçlandırma çekirdeğinde destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki yaratma ve yapma örnekleri, genel bir var etme anlamına genişletilmeden bu sınır içinde kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca yapma, kusursuzca tamamlama ve eylemi yürürlüğe koyma çekirdeğidir; salt planlama, ölçme veya sözlü karar verme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yapıp kusursuzca tamamlama çekirdeğini belirli yaratma, iş görme ve sağlam ürün söz öbeklerinden ayırır; bu örneklerin özel kapsamı çıplak biçime taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yapıp biçim vererek sağlam ve kusursuz duruma getirmek veya tasarlanan bir eylemi kararlılıkla gerçekleştirip yürürlüğe koymaktır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi yapma, biçimlendirme ve işi kusursuzca tamamlayarak sağlam duruma getirme.
Tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla gerçekleştirip amaçlanan sonuca kadar yürütme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi yapıp kusursuzca tamamlamayı ve istenen eylemi sonuca kadar yürütmeyi ortaklaştırır; yaratma örneği de ortaya çıkarma ile işi bitirme aşamalarını birlikte taşır.

concept_gloss.text: yapıp kusursuzca tamamlamak ve yürürlüğe koymak
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir ürünün sağlam biçimde ortaya çıkarılması ile bir eylemin kararlılıkla gerçekleştirilmesini ortak sonuçlandırma yönüyle karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma, biçimlendirme, kusursuzca tamamlama ve eylemi gerçekleştirme yönlerini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma, biçim verme ve sağlam biçimde tamamlama yönlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesne üretmeyen bir eylemi yürürlüğe koyma yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi amaçlanan sonuca kadar gerçekleştirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir nesneyi yapıp kusursuz ve sağlam duruma getirme yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İşin sağlam ve kusursuz biçimde tamamlanmasını ve yürürlüğe konmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İyi veya kötü, özenli veya özensiz her türlü genel eylem ve işi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir etkenin bir şeyi yapmasını veya bir eylemi gerçekleştirmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel yapma ve eylemdir; odak dal ise işin kusursuzlaştırılması ve amaçlanan sonuca kadar yürütülmesi sınırını taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tasarlanan şeyi fiilen yapıp tamamlar ve uygulanır duruma getirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eylemden önce ölçme, oranlama ve nasıl yapılacağını belirleme aşamasında kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ortaya çıkacak şeyin düzenli ve belirlenmiş olmasına katkıda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal hazırlık niteliğindeki ölçme ve tasarlamadır; odak dal bu tasarıyı fiilen gerçekleştirip tamamlamadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mevcut bir ürünü işleyip kusursuzlaştırmayı ve genel bir eylemi yürürlüğe koymayı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi ilk kez varlığa çıkarma ve başlangıcını oluşturma yönünü özellikle taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şeyin etken tarafından ortaya çıkarılması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal başlangıç ve ilk var edişe odaklanır; odak dal yapımın tamamlanması, kusursuzlaştırılması ve eylemin uygulanması çevresindedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yapma, önceden tasarlama ve ilk var ediş en belirleyici sınırları verdi, yalnızca benzer yaratma örneklerini yineleyen adaylar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خلق الشيء وصنعه وتقديره وإحكامه، والعمل النافذ، وإمضاء ما يراد فعله
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد الحكم القولي ولا الإعلام، ولا فساد السقاء أو أكل القضى
branches.source_phrase_ar: قضاه أي صنعه وقدره ومنه فقضاهن سبع سموات (sihah); كل ما أحكم فقد قضي وخلقهن وعملهن وصنعهن وفاقض ما أنت قاض أي فاعمل (tahdhib); فقضاهن سبع سماوات إشارة إلى إيجاده الإبداعي والفراغ منه (mufradat); أصل يدل على إحكام أمر وإتقانه وإنفاذه لجهته (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, borçlunun borcu geri vererek ilişkiyi kapatmasını ve alacaklının hakkını istemesi ya da tahsil etmesini destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki zorunlu ödemede geçerli sayılan deve, yalnızca ayrı bir sözcük biriminin tanıklığıdır ve dal düzeyindeki kaynak ifadesinde bulunmadığı için çekirdek tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, borç veya hakkın ödeme, isteme ve tahsil yoluyla kapatılmasıyla sınırlıdır; yargısal karar ve genel bitirme anlamlarından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, borç ödeme söz öbeği ile isteme ve tahsil biçimlerini ayrı katılımcı yönleri olarak korur; tek bir kalıbın kapsamı bütün çıplak biçimlere yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Borçlunun borcu geri vererek alacak ilişkisini kapatması veya alacaklının kendisine düşen malı ya da hakkı isteyip teslim almasıdır.

facets.statement: Borçlunun borcu sahibine geri vererek aradaki yükümlülüğü kapatması.
Alacaklının hakkını borçludan istemesi ve teslim alarak tahsil etmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, borcun geri verilerek ilişkinin kapatılmasını ve alacaklının ödenmesini istemesi ya da malını teslim almasını iki katılımcı yönüyle ortaklaşa sunar.

concept_gloss.text: borcu ödeyerek veya tahsil ederek kapatmak
concept_gloss.applicability: Borçlunun ödeme, alacaklının isteme ve teslim alma yönlerini aynı borç ilişkisinin kapanması çevresinde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Borcu geri verme, hakkı isteme, tahsil etme ve ilişkiyi kapatma yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Borçlunun yükümlü olduğu şeyi sahibine geri vererek borç ilişkisini kapattığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Borçlunun geri ödeme yaparak yükümlülüğü sona erdirmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Alacaklının hakkını isteme ve teslim alarak tahsil etme yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Alacaklının kendisine düşen malı veya hakkı istediği ve teslim aldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alacaklının isteme ve teslim alarak hakkını elde etme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Borçlunun kendi yükümlülüğünü yerine getirerek borcu kapatma yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal çeşitli hak ve emanetlerin ödenmesine uzanır; odak dal borç ilişkisini hem borçlu hem alacaklı açısından kapatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Borçlunun gönüllü veya zorunlu geri ödemesini de çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir hakkın peşine düşüp istemeyi sürdürme ve ısrarlı takip yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da alacaklının kendisine düşen hakkı borçludan istemesini ve elde etmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ödeme ve tahsille ilişkinin kapanmasını içerir; komşu dal alacaklının süren isteme ve takip eylemine yoğunlaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Borçlunun borcu geri vererek yükümlülüğü kapatma yönünü açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ortakların birbirinden karşılık istemesi biçimindeki karşılıklı hesaplaşmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal alacağın istenmesi ve sahibine geçerek tahsil edilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal isteme ve karşılıklı tahsile odaklanır; odak dal bunlara borçlunun geri ödemesiyle ilişkinin kapanmasını ekler.
